40 minutes of gentle cartoon stories and sing-along songs for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2–6) with Honey Bunny, Pip Puppy, Dotty Duckling, Lulu Lamb, Ollie Owl and Mimi Kitten. Friendly host scenes between stories invite little ones to answer, count and join in. Every spoken line has captions.

What's inside (and what your child practises):
🍂 Pip Puppy's Big Leaf Pile – working together, taking turns, autumn leaf colours and counting to 5.
☔ Pip and Mama Bunny's Rainy-Day Fort – sharing, colours and pretend play on a rainy day.
🦆 Why Doesn't Dotty Duckling Get Wet? – how duck feathers stay dry, counting raindrops, dressing for the weather.
🦉 Ollie Owl's Animal Sounds Song – sing and move along: hoo, baa, quack, woof, meow!
🐑 Lulu Lamb's Big and Small Picnic – opposites (big/small, up/down, fast/slow) and being gentle with tiny creatures.
🌙 Lulu Lamb's Sleepy Animal Stretches – calming animal stretches and slow breaths before bed.
🔔 Ollie Owl Helps Find Mimi's Bell – it's okay to feel worried and ask friends for help; listening for night sounds.

The last two stories are calm and sleepy, so this also works as a wind-down before nap or bedtime.

💛 Share with a parent who needs 40 calm minutes of happy stories today!
